nodes.name: Python for Data

topics.title: Data visualisation with Matplotlib and Seaborn

miniTasks: Solve 15 Python exercises covering data structures and functions.
Clean and analyse a real CSV dataset with Pandas.
Produce five meaningful charts from your dataset.

resources.title: CS50’s Introduction to Programming with Python
resources.why: Harvard CS50’s Python course builds programming fundamentals with hands-on problem sets and projects, making it a structured starting point for core CS skills.

resources.title: Python Official Tutorial
resources.why: Authoritative tutorial covering Python syntax and core language features.

resources.title: Exercism Python Track
resources.why: Large set of progressively structured Python exercises reinforces language fundamentals, clean implementations, and problem-solving habits.

nodes.name: Machine Learning

topics.title: The ML workflow: regression and classification

miniTasks: Build and evaluate a regression model on a real dataset.
Compare four models on one classification task.
Improve your model with cross-validation and feature engineering and report the gain.

resources.title: Google ML Crash Course – Linear Regression
resources.why: Covers loss, gradient descent, model parameters and hyperparameter tuning through a practical ML module.

resources.title: Google ML Crash Course – Logistic Regression
resources.why: Explains sigmoid probabilities, log loss and regularization for binary classification.

resources.title: Google ML Crash Course – Classification
resources.why: Covers thresholds, confusion matrices, precision, recall, ROC and AUC for classification evaluation.

resources.title: Google ML Crash Course – Working with Numerical Data
resources.why: Focuses on scaling, normalization, binning and preparing numerical features for ML models.

resources.title: scikit-learn – Preprocessing data
resources.why: Exact API guide for scaling, normalization, encoding, imputation and polynomial feature transforms before modeling.

resources.title: scikit-learn – Metrics and scoring
resources.why: Specific API reference for regression and classification metrics, scoring functions, probability metrics and custom scorers.

resources.title: scikit-learn – Cross-validation
resources.why: Explains K-fold, stratified and repeated cross-validation and how to evaluate estimators on unseen folds.

resources.title: scikit-learn – Ensemble methods
resources.why: Covers random forests, gradient boosting, bagging, voting and stacking, including practical estimator APIs.

resources.title: Google Machine Learning Crash Course – Exercises
resources.why: Current exercise hub with browser-based programming, interactives and quizzes for regression, classification, preprocessing, neural networks, embeddings, LLMs, production ML and fairness.

resources.title: StatQuest: PCA Step-by-Step
resources.why: Walks through PCA step-by-step, including variance, components, SVD, eigenvectors, and dimensionality reduction.

resources.title: StatQuest: K-means clustering
resources.why: Explains K-means, choosing K, assigning points, updating centroids, and interpreting clusters.

resources.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals: Cross Validation
resources.why: Explains how cross-validation compares models and supports model selection and hyperparameter tuning.

nodes.name: Deep Learning
miniTasks: Implement a small neural network from scratch on a toy dataset.
Reimplement your network in PyTorch and train it.
Train an image classifier and report accuracy with a confusion matrix.

resources.title: Google ML Crash Course – Neural Networks
resources.why: Explains nodes, hidden layers, activation functions, inference and backpropagation for neural-network training.

resources.title: PyTorch – Learn the Basics
resources.why: End-to-end beginner path covering tensors, datasets, transforms, model building, autograd, optimization and saving models.

resources.title: PyTorch – Quickstart
resources.why: Builds a complete small classification workflow using Dataset, DataLoader, model definition, training and evaluation.

resources.title: PyTorch – Tensors
resources.why: Specific tutorial on tensor creation, attributes, indexing, arithmetic, concatenation and device movement.

resources.title: PyTorch – Datasets & DataLoaders
resources.why: Shows how custom Dataset and DataLoader objects structure batches and feed training loops efficiently.

resources.title: PyTorch – Build the Neural Network
resources.why: Constructs an nn.Module for image classification and demonstrates layers, parameters and accelerator selection.

resources.title: PyTorch – Automatic Differentiation with torch.autograd
resources.why: Explains gradient tracking, requires_grad and backpropagation mechanics used to train neural networks.

resources.title: PyTorch – Deep Learning: A 60 Minute Blitz
resources.why: Compact official introduction to tensors, autograd, neural networks and training a small image classifier.

resources.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
resources.why: Introduces residual learning and skip connections that make very deep convolutional networks easier to optimize.

resources.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
resources.why: Defines the Adam optimizer using adaptive estimates of gradient moments for efficient stochastic optimization.

resources.title: Neural Networks Pt. 2: Backpropagation Main Ideas
resources.why: Explains the core intuition of backpropagation and how gradients update neural-network parameters.

resources.title: Tensors for Neural Networks, Clearly Explained!!!
resources.why: Explains tensors as multidimensional arrays and connects them to neural-network data structures.

nodes.name: NLP and Transformers
miniTasks: Build a sentiment analyser with word embeddings.
Explain self-attention and implement a minimal attention block.
Fine-tune a pretrained model on a small text task and evaluate it.

resources.title: Google ML Crash Course – Embeddings
resources.why: Introduces embedding vectors, embedding spaces and how high-dimensional categorical data can be represented compactly.

resources.title: TensorFlow – Text Classification
resources.why: Implements binary sentiment classification with TensorFlow using text preprocessing, vectorization, embeddings and a neural model.

resources.title: TensorFlow – Word Embeddings
resources.why: Shows how embedding layers turn token IDs into dense vectors and how embeddings are trained for text classification.

resources.title: TensorFlow – Transformer
resources.why: Implements a Transformer sequence-to-sequence model and exposes attention, encoder-decoder structure and masking.

resources.title: Hugging Face LLM Course – Introduction
resources.why: Introduces NLP, LLMs, Transformer model families and the pipeline API within the current Hugging Face course.

resources.title: Hugging Face LLM Course – How do Transformers work?
resources.why: Explains encoder-only, decoder-only and encoder-decoder architectures plus attention and causal versus masked language modeling.

resources.title: Hugging Face LLM Course – Transformers Library Introduction
resources.why: Explains the Transformers library architecture, tokenizer/model pairing and the unified API for pretrained models.

resources.title: Attention Is All You Need
resources.why: Foundational Transformer paper introducing an architecture based solely on attention rather than recurrence or convolution for sequence transduction.

resources.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
resources.why: Introduces bidirectional Transformer pretraining with masked language modeling and next-sentence prediction, followed by task-specific fine-tuning.

resources.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
resources.why: Introduces ViT, applying a pure Transformer to sequences of image patches for image classification.

resources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
resources.why: Introduces low-rank trainable matrices that adapt frozen Transformer weights with far fewer trainable parameters than full fine-tuning.

resources.title: Cosine Similarity, Clearly Explained!!!
resources.why: Explains cosine similarity geometrically and why it is useful for comparing high-dimensional vectors.

nodes.name: MLOps and Deployment

topics.title: Model serialisation and serving through an API

miniTasks: Serve a trained model through a REST API.
Containerise and deploy your model API with a public URL.
Add logging, a data-drift check and a reproducible training script.

resources.title: scikit-learn – Pipelines and composite estimators
resources.why: Shows how to chain preprocessing and prediction safely and supports reproducible model workflows with Pipeline and ColumnTransformer.

resources.title: Google ML Crash Course – Production ML Systems
resources.why: Covers production ML architecture, data pipelines, monitoring and deployment concerns beyond model training.

resources.title: Google ML Crash Course – Automated Machine Learning (AutoML)
resources.why: Explains when automated model search is useful and the trade-offs involved in automated ML workflows.

resources.title: PyTorch – Save and Load the Model
resources.why: Shows state_dict-based saving, loading and inference so trained models can be reused outside the training session.

resources.title: Hugging Face LLM Course – Sharing pretrained models
resources.why: Shows push_to_hub workflows and how model repositories preserve trained weights, tokenizers and reproducibility metadata.

resources.title: Hugging Face – Building a model card
resources.why: Specific guidance on documenting training data, evaluation, limitations, biases and metadata in model cards.

resources.title: Kaggle – Machine Learning Explainability
resources.why: Teaches permutation importance, partial dependence and SHAP-style reasoning for interpreting model predictions.
